name: FOOD Co
address: Knysna Rd & 4th St, Loerie Park, George, 6529, South Africa
description_short: Café, bakery and deli serving fresh meals and artisan breads in a relaxed Loerie Park setting.
description_long:
FOOD Co brings together a café, bakery and deli under one roof in George's Loerie Park. The aroma of freshly baked breads and pastries greets you as you step inside, while the café serves everything from breakfast staples to light lunches and proper coffee. The deli counter stocks local produce, artisan goods and ready-made meals for those on the go.

The space has a relaxed, community feel where you can settle in with a coffee and pastry or grab provisions for the road. It's the kind of neighbourhood spot that works equally well for a weekday breakfast meeting or a weekend browse through the deli shelves. The bakery turns out quality breads daily, and the café menu keeps things simple and well-executed.
